root_text:
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) symptoms are:

- Runny or stuffy nose
- Cough
- Shortness of breath
- Sore throat
- Wheezing
- Fever
- Rash

#StaySafe #BeVigilant #NeverAgain https://t.co/g9YzTIbRux
